LicenseIdentification.name: License Identification
LicenseIdentification.definition: Identification of the driver license (for example, driver license number).

LicenseAssigner.name: License Assigner
LicenseAssigner.definition: Authority assigning an identification to a driver license.

LicenseIssuanceDate.name: License Issuance Date
LicenseIssuanceDate.definition: Date of issuance of the driving license.

LicenseExpirationDate.name: License Expiration Date
LicenseExpirationDate.definition: Expiration date of the driving license (if and when relevant).

LicenseCountrySubDivisionMajor.name: License Country Sub Division Major
LicenseCountrySubDivisionMajor.definition: Country Sub Division major issuing the driver license (if and when relevant).

LicenseCountrySubDivisionMinor.name: License Country Sub Division Minor
LicenseCountrySubDivisionMinor.definition: Country Sub Division minor issuing the driver license (if and when relevant).

LicenseOtherAuthority.name: License Other Authority
LicenseOtherAuthority.definition: Other authority issuing a driver license.

EmployeeIdentification.name: Employee Identification
EmployeeIdentification.definition: Contains the employee identification number as assigned by the fleet operator.

DepartmentNumber.name: Department Number
DepartmentNumber.definition: Contains the fleet driver's department number as assigned by the fleet operator.

AdditionalIdentification.name: Additional Identification
AdditionalIdentification.definition: Additional identification used for the driver.

DateOfBirth.name: Date Of Birth
DateOfBirth.definition: Date of birth of vehicle rental driver.

PrivateData.name: Private Data
PrivateData.definition: Reserved for private data. The use of this data element is determined by bilateral agreement.

NationalData.name: National Data
NationalData.definition: Reserved to define data unique to the country applications.
